items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: We all joined the Navy band in the year of September the 4th, 1942... a fellow by the name of Henry Russ, Gilbert Young, two trumpet men and myself.

ctx.x: And still where the Jolly Bunch starts out from.

Jolly Boys, that's where they have their parade starts out from. And we formally made it the WPA band. And I worked in that outfit all through the 30s, all through the 33. Clean all the way up to, way up you can say up to 1942. All that many years. Yeah. And when John and Navy band. You were talking about the WPA band again? Yeah. I went to the WPA band in November of 1933. And worked through there all through the 30s and stood with the band in which I was the last drummer in there when it comes out on the…

I remember one time, excuse me for interrupting, you were telling us how, I think it was up when you were playing at the Paddock or at the Mardi Gras, one of those two places one night. You were talking quite a while about when you played at the Navy band, you went up there and they recognized immediately that you had a different kind of a beat.
